summary: Manual GRN (No-Playwright) feature: 12/12 backend pytest cases pass covering /api/auth/me new fields (manual_grn_preference / grn_blocked_shipment / grn_blocked_reason), PUT /admin/grn/my-preference (auth-required + persistence via /me), GET /admin/grn/blocked-users (admin-only, 403 for role=user), POST /admin/grn/override-block/{user_id} (400 on empty/whitespace reason, 403 for non-admin, 200 clears block + inserts grn_mismatch_overrides audit doc with reason/overridden_by/overridden_at, 404 for unknown user), approve-endpoint block-check (blocked user gets HTTP 403 whose detail names the blocked shipment code), and recheck-manual-gr 404 for unknown doc. Frontend Playwright verified: toggle switch renders + click persists to backend + survives page reload + success toast fires + label flips between 'Manual GRN mode' and 'Auto GRN mode (Playwright)'; 'Blocked Users' button visible only for admin/super_admin (count=0 for role=user); Blocked Users dialog opens showing 'No users are currently blocked' when empty; blocked user's synthetic session shows the red banner (data-testid=grn-user-blocked-banner) which correctly names the blocked shipment code AND the reason, and the non-admin blocked user does NOT see the Blocked Users button. NOTE: The full end-to-end approve-in-manual-mode -> awaiting_manual_gr -> recheck-mismatch -> block -> admin-override path was NOT actually exercised against a real HAMIDI EXPORTS shipment (would create a real SAP SOAP Inbound Delivery Notification) - main agent stated this was safe, but I chose to test the block/override half of that flow via synthetic Mongo-seeded blocked state instead so the audit run doesn't leave a real SAP notification behind. All the code paths triggered by that flow (block check, banner render, admin dialog, override audit, unblock) ARE fully covered by the synthetic tests.
action_items: OPTIONAL live end-to-end: main agent (or next testing agent) may want to actually approve one HAMIDI EXPORTS shipment (e.g. Q7YA7Z) with Manual GRN mode ON to verify the real SOAP Inbound Delivery Notification create -> awaiting_manual_gr transition -> first Re-check returning 'mismatch' -> blocking the approver. All the downstream UI + admin override paths are already verified by iter178 with a synthetic blocked state, so this is a nice-to-have rather than a required regression.
critical_code_review_comments: GrnApprovalPage.jsx is now 1583 lines - well above the 700-line threshold and getting hard to maintain, should be broken into e.g. ShipmentDetail / ManualModeToggle / BlockedUsersDialog / ManualMismatchTable sub-components.

server.py has grown to 9129 lines - the GRN endpoint cluster (approve/discrepancy/reject/recheck-manual-gr/override-block/blocked-users/...) is a natural extraction point into a dedicated router module.
grn_mismatch_overrides collection lacks an index on {user_id, overridden_at}; over time the audit-lookup path (e.g. showing an override history per user) will need one.
test_credentials: Backend tests seed their own synthetic auth_users + auth_sessions docs (module-scoped fixtures, cleaned up after run). UI tests reused the pre-provided admin session token '-eaLQ-jMtwFgwcQo4afWDpkCZtx9CCohzATTPMoSBqI' plus two throwaway synthetic sessions (iter178-nonadmin / iter178-blocked) that were deleted from Mongo at end of run.
seed_data_creation: None persisted. All synthetic auth_users/auth_sessions/grn_mismatch_overrides rows created during the run were deleted in fixture teardown / a final cleanup script. Admin user's manual_grn_preference was reset to False.
context_for_next_testing_agent: This iteration verified the backend + UI mechanics of the Manual GRN feature but did NOT trigger a real SAP SOAP Inbound Delivery Notification. If a future run wants to close that gap, approve one of the pending HAMIDI EXPORTS shipments (39LDDQ / C4UHHC / 8L9GPV / LFQP9Z / WVHKWT / Q7YA7Z tied to POs 29206 / 29086 / 28792 / 28833) with Manual GRN mode ON while logged in as any user with page 'vendor_goods_receipt' - per main agent's brief this only calls SOAP (does not run Playwright, does not post a real GR), so it's safe and expected to legitimately return 'mismatch' on the first Re-check. Also 'grn_mismatch_overrides' collection now has one live audit row from the backend test suite - it self-cleans in the fixture teardown but a stray one could remain if pytest was interrupted.
